summary: Enhance your skills with our comprehensive Agency Banking Training. Learn the essentials to excel in the evolving financial landscape. Enroll today!
lede: Agency banking extends financial services through third-party agents, and this course is for professionals managing agent operations. It covers the practical work of designing and overseeing agent networks, from selecting and onboarding agents to planning liquidity and monitoring performance. Learners also explore risk controls, AML and consumer protection, plus technology integration for agent services.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who lead, manage, or support agency banking operations. It targets intermediate-level practitioners with 2-5 years of banking experience who need to design, launch, or optimize agent networks. Whether you're expanding into rural markets, urban neighborhoods, or specialized service segments, you'll leave with actionable tools and a clear roadmap. This course is designed for: Agency Banking Manager:
audience: Network Operations Leader: Oversee daily agent operations
Compliance Officer: Implement AML and consumer protection
Financial Inclusion Strategist: Expand outreach to underserved
Branch Manager: Manage agent relationships and service
Risk Analyst: Assess agent risks and implement
Technology Integration Specialist: Deploy mobile money
Liquidity Manager: Forecast cash needs and manage
Performance Analyst: Track agent KPIs and optimize
prerequisites: Prerequisites include working knowledge of banking operations and basic financial concepts. No coding or advanced technical skills are required. Participants should bring their organization's current agent network data (if available) to apply exercises to real contexts.
